trusted_statements.goal: Build the permanent renderer-neutral Direct / Non-Tiled Reference Source used as the correctness oracle for later Tile and RenderGroup optimizations.
consumes: optional explicitly supplied per-view transient snapshot
trusted_statements.group_semantics: Group may contribute zero pixels but must retain deterministic traversal and order semantics.
determinism: The plan carries exact scene/frame/view/query identity and renderer-neutral command values.

The plan carries an explicit deterministic renderer-neutral world-to-view mapping derived from CameraState and logical viewport metrics, plus the viewport clip; commands remain independent of backend surface types.
Digest input is a versioned canonical byte encoding of the complete reference plan; digest never substitutes for structural equality.
Identical RuntimeScene, VisibilityResult, and FrameState input produces byte-identical canonical plan bytes and digest.
trusted_statements.locality: The normal source path is driven only by ordered visible IDs, performs one RuntimeScene read-contract lookup per visible ID, never iterates RuntimeScene.records(), and never iterates semantic objects.
forbidden: generic stale Stroke or Text kind
SemanticDocument, ObjectStore, semantic object lookup, or SceneCompiler access
Tile, TileCache, RenderGroup, RasterCache, Scheduler, or ResourceBudget behavior
prediction, ink preview, Arc handoff, or CanonicalVisible semantics
declaring ReferenceDrawList to be the final optimized FrameGraph ABI
required_evidence: one fixture covering all nine V1 kinds plus order, viewport/erase clip, and independently calculated camera mapping
deterministic exact structural replay and byte-identical digest replay
100000 total RuntimeScene records with approximately 500 ordered visible inputs and exactly visible-driven traversal
production boundary scan proving no semantic, Skia, Tile, backend, or later-WP dependency
